mapper.select: SELECT id, perms, data_permission FROM sys_permission WHERE perms = #{permissionCode} AND perms != '' AND menu_type IN (2, 3) AND deleted = 0 AND status = 0

SELECT p.perms FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.perms != '' AND p.menu_type IN (2, 3)

SELECT ur.user_id FROM sys_role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE rp.permission_id = #{permissionId} UNION SELECT ur.user_id FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 WHERE r.role_code = 'superadmin' AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0

SELECT rp.permission_id FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
